Texto: Debuted as the main rapper of the multinational boy group UNIQ under Yuehua Entertainment with Falling in Love and EOEO.
Adopted his first solo stage name to showcase his rapping and underground hip-hop style, appearing on Show Me The Money 5 and releasing Recipe and Baby Ride.
Officially changed his solo moniker to WOODZ, transitioning toward alternative R&B and singer-songwriter production with singles like Pool and Different.
Competed on Mnet’s survival show, finishing 5th overall to debut in the project group X1, which promoted the massive hit Flash before an early disbandment in 2020.
Returned to Yuehua Entertainment full-time as a solo artist, launching a continuous run of highly acclaimed self-produced albums including EQUAL, WOOPS!, SET, Only Lovers Left, and Colorful Trauma.
Signed with his current agency, fully leaning into indie-rock and grunge aesthetics with the landmark album OO-LI, the viral mega-hit Drowning, and his post-military comeback album Archive. 1.
